articles.headline: Cloudflare shares jump after forecast raise on higher AI-driven spending
articles.summary: Cloudflare raised its annual forecast, saying enterprise spending on AI infrastructure is boosting demand for its networking and security products. That suggests businesses are still increasing AI-related infrastructure budgets, which may affect cloud, security, and edge-network spending plans.

articles.headline: US productivity rises faster than expected as firms invest in AI
articles.summary: U.S. worker productivity grew faster than expected in the second quarter, and Reuters says further gains are likely as businesses invest in artificial intelligence. For business leaders, this points to AI continuing to support output growth while helping contain wage inflation, which can affect hiring plans, pricing, and margins.

articles.headline: SpaceX shares fall after first earnings report as AI spending climbs
articles.summary: SpaceX reported revenue growth and narrower losses, but investors sold the stock after it highlighted heavy AI-related capital spending, including data centers. The reaction matters for businesses because it reinforces how quickly AI infrastructure can absorb capital and shape market expectations for infrastructure-intensive companies.
